rules: The presence of a native v2 command does not by itself transfer ownership; each app_server_v2 row is an explicit adoption decision scoped to a migration slice.
No operation may read or write Letta durable storage directly; every owner routes through a public contract (v2 protocol, bounded service adapter, or controller-owned state).
The Kotlin controller must not become admin-shim v2: admin_rest_service and vibesync_service rows are bounded injected adapters, not REST mirrors grown inside the fanout controller.
capability_gated_unsupported rows fail closed with an explicit capability error after cutover; they must never silently proxy.
production_first_route and current_backend describe observed production execution order; post_shim_owner/post_shim_fallback are cutover targets and must never be shim_until_cutover.

unrouted_domains.current_state: lettashim (SHIM_CHANNELS_ENABLED=1) is the live channels host: it imports ~/.letta/channels/*/plugin.mjs (matrix, mobile) and serves /v1/channels/*. No Iroh admin_rpc surface. Upstream letta-code 0.29.12 DOES accept channel_* over the app-server WS under --listen with no handshake, but initializeChannels() is unreachable at boot there, so enabled accounts are never auto-restored.
unrouted_domains.decision: CONTROLLER-NATIVE BEHIND A FLAG (lgns8.23). ChannelRestoreCoordinator (sharedLogic) closes the boot-restore gap client-side: channels_list -> channel_accounts_list -> channel_start for every enabled account, re-issued on EVERY generation-ready because channel_start also re-wires ingress to the issuing socket. Shipped OFF behind --channels-host / LETTA_CHANNELS_HOST; production keeps lettashim as host until the maintenance-window cutover (flag on + SHIM_CHANNELS_ENABLED=0) — two hosts would double-start the same accounts. This is NOT an admin_rpc exposure: channel_* frames are controller-initiated and controller-internal, never fanned out to viewers, because channel_accounts_list returns plugin config (Matrix accessToken/syncAccessToken) in CLEARTEXT. Any future VIEWER-facing channel surface still requires the explicit per-command sensitive-capability policy of lgns8.12.
unrouted_domains.evidence: EMPIRICAL, letta-mobile-lgns8.23.1 probe 2026-07-31 against letta-code 0.29.12 on a throwaway HOME: (1) channel_* accepted on a bare socket with no handshake; (2) our matrix plugin discovered via channel.json and started to running=true with a live sync; (3) boot-restore absent after appserver restart (enabled=true, running=false) until a client-issued channel_start restored it; (4) a repeated channel_start is a clean stop+start, exactly one sync loop, no leak; (5) a FAILED channel_start persists enabled:false into accounts.json — hence the enabled re-assertion in the coordinator; (6) channel_accounts_list returns accessToken/syncAccessToken in cleartext.
unrouted_domains.successor: controller_native (ChannelRestoreCoordinator, flag-gated --channels-host; cutover deferred to the lgns8.11 maintenance window)

unrouted_domains.decision: DEAD as an external surface — deny fail-closed. The Kotlin fail-closed policy layer (lgns8.12) is the sole policy authority after cutover; a second, shim-resident policy store that clients can PUT would be a fail-open bypass of it. Any future preview/dry-run affordance must be a method on the Kotlin policy layer, not a proxy to this route.

unrouted_domains.decision: DEAD as a route (deny fail-closed; never proxied over admin_rpc) but its SENSING value must be replaced before the shim's runtime role retires — losing the only view of pooled session state would be a sensing regression. Proposal: extend controller-native introspection with a read-only admin_read diagnostics method (proposed health.diagnostics) reporting controller session/lease occupancy, queued/in-flight session starts, reconnect state, and a coarse process snapshot. Specified and tracked by letta-mobile-lgns8.25.2; not implemented in this bead.
